blinding_guess.why: The packet lists GLOBAL_POSITION_INT under both mavlink::common::msg and mavlink::standard::msg, which suggests the message moved dialect namespace in the mavlink dependency; this revision decodes it only as mavlink::common::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT (global_position.cpp:301), while already using mavlink::standard::msg for AUTOPILOT_VERSION, so it would fail to build against a mavlink release where the struct lives only in the standard dialect.

notes: All seven packet elements are consumed-side C++ API symbols from the external mavlink dependency (generated from dialect XML, not in the snapshot), so declares and not_declared are empty. Package scope is snapshot/mavros (package.xml name mavros, version 2.13.0); the snapshot also holds libmavconn, mavros_msgs, mavros_extras (mavros_extras/src/plugins/gps_status.cpp:74 also references mavlink::common::msg::GPS_RAW_INT, not counted here). api:mavlink::standard::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT is not referenced anywhere in the snapshot (grep 'standard::' finds only MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY and msg::AUTOPILOT_VERSION), so it has no port and no reference. GPS_RAW_INT, GLOBAL_POSITION_INT, GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN and LOCAL_POSITION_NED_SYSTEM_GLOBAL_OFFSET are received via plugin::make_handler with filter SystemAndOk; SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN is built from ~/set_gp_origin (geographic_msgs/GeoPointStamped) and sent with uas->send_message; mavlink::mavlink_message_t is the raw frame pointer in every handler signature. msg_type is null because these are MAVLink C++ structs, not ROS pkg/Type messages; definition_id is null because their definitions are mavlink dialect XML, which is outside the allowed definition file kinds and not in the snapshot; qos is null because MAVLink traffic goes over the mavconn link, not a DDS topic. Frames recorded are the hard-coded parameter defaults the code stamps on the converted data (runtime-overridable; launch/px4_config.yaml:49-59 and apm_config.yaml:50-60 set the same values): GPS_RAW_INT and GLOBAL_POSITION_INT NavSatFix headers use child_frame_id (default base_link), while their velocity/odometry outputs use frame_id (default map, global_position.cpp:71, 266, 340); GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN and LOCAL_POSITION_NED_SYSTEM_GLOBAL_OFFSET use tf.global_frame_id (default earth). SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN frame is null: the incoming GeoPointStamped header.frame_id is not read (global_position.cpp:544-556). SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN units null: code scales latitude/longitude * 1E7 and (altitude + ellipsoid_to_geoid_height) * 1E3 without stating units (global_position.cpp:550-553). GLOBAL_POSITION_INT velocity is mapped as Eigen::Vector3d(gpos.vy, gpos.vx, gpos.vz) / 1E2 (line 345).
